test_run.command: uv run --locked --no-sync pytest tests/test_coding_v2_approval.py tests/test_sandbox_transport.py tests/test_sandbox_status.py tests/test_remote_coding.py -q
skip_reasons_in_source: Sandbox daemon requires a POSIX host.
Sandbox transport uses a Linux daemon.

local_boundary_probe.original_execution_location: temporary research directory outside the repository
local_boundary_probe.scope: Direct invocation of the existing CodingEngine, Permissions, FileService and ProcessManager with synthetic temporary files.
limitations: Does not exercise dashboard authentication or tool catalog admission.
Assumes shell access is available and the shell command is not denied by a shell-specific policy.
Does not modify real approval records or credentials.
Does not demonstrate escape from a cloud provider sandbox.
Does not establish behavior on Linux or macOS.
Temporary synthetic files are retained for inspection.
